first_order_identity_at_fixed_query.definitions: For one head/query: s=Z W_K q/sqrt(d), p=softmax(s), V=Z W_V, o=p^T V.
first_order_identity_at_fixed_query.differential: do = p^T dZ W_V + (diag(p)-p p^T)[dZ W_K q/sqrt(d)] transposed times V.
first_order_identity_at_fixed_query.interpretation: Two paths exist. Their existence does not show gradient conflict, key drift, or causal harm in the current E/P study.
first_order_identity_at_fixed_query.fixed_query_limit: In a full trajectory q changes with the latent; fixed keys do NOT fix attention maps or preserve baseline spatial layout.

candidate_forward.not_equivalent: Freezing W_K while changing shared Z does not freeze K. A true separate input is required; the previously audited key stack has no supported nonzero common numerical kernel.

learning_and_claim_limits: This is a conditioning-architecture candidate, not a sampler change or a claimed new mathematical theorem.
The previous per-stimulus true-image oracle proves only selected fixed-QK response capacity; one EEG predictor across new stimuli has NOT been learned or verified.
Do not use the current training prefix to tune epochs, learning rates, clip thresholds, loss weights, or strengths, or to replace the original primary arm.

If later implemented, require actual generated-image improvement over frozen ordinary and a matched common-input policy, plus correct versus same-concept wrong EEG controls. A c-only input control would test whether raw EEG outside the frozen condition is used.
The current five fits all include O. Standalone or independent additive-method claims require a separately trained matched no-O cell; inference-only O bypass is not that cell.
No extension from four historical layers/eight T stimuli to all70 layers, EEG physiology, heldout quality, SOTA or CCF A acceptance.
